name: io.github.maarmapa/storefront-mcp
description: E-commerce storefront over MCP: public catalog tools (search, product detail, variant charts with per-variant stock, promotions, quotes) for AI agents, plus 5 token-gated back-office tools (stock, orders, sales) for the store owner.

environmentVariables.name: CATALOG_ADAPTER
environmentVariables.description: Which catalog adapter to use: "memory" (bundled demo catalog, no setup) or "woocommerce" (Store API skeleton).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Unlocks the 5 sensitive back-office tools (stock, orders, sales). On stdio the presence of this variable in the server process env unlocks them; leave it unset to expose only the 6 public catalog tools.
